title: KleptoKitty
author: Eoin McGrath
desc_full: About “If a black cat crosses your path, count your diamonds, for they may vanish by dawn” You are Kleptokitty - whisker-twitching, tail-flicking, diamond-snatching master of meow-heist mischief. The mansion is full of riches, traps, and clueless guards… but none of them stand a chance against the purrfect crime. How To Play Swipe / Arrow keys / WASD to move Find keys Collect loot Escape …and don’t get caught [M] to mute. Made with LittleJS
